OAK Beauty là nền tảng đặt lịch làm đẹp: OAK Beauty is a beauty booking platform in Ho Chi Minh City, connecting you with hand-picked nail, hair, skincare, spa and eyelash salons — all in one place.
Đặt lịch làm đẹp ở Việt Nam vẫn còn là c: Booking a beauty appointment in Vietnam still means messages, phone calls and price lists nobody is sure about. Customers lose time asking around, and salons lose customers simply because one message slipped through.
OAK Beauty ra đời để xoá bỏ khoảng cách: OAK Beauty exists to close that gap: one place where you can clearly see each salon's services, prices, durations and open time slots, then book in seconds.
Với các chủ salon, chúng tôi mang đến mộ: For salon owners, we provide a tool to manage appointments, services, staff and revenue — free during the early stage, so they can focus on what they do best.

Three steps, not a single phone call.
Mô tả nhu cầu bằng tiếng Việt tự nhiên —: Describe what you need in everyday Vietnamese — "men's haircut District 3", "relaxing massage under 500k" — or browse by category: nails, hair, skincare, spa and eyelashes.
Chọn dịch vụ, chuyên viên và khung giờ c: Choose your service, your specialist and an open time slot. Your appointment is confirmed instantly and always sits in My appointments, ready for you to track or cancel.
Đến salon đúng giờ, thanh toán trực tiếp: Arrive at the salon on time and pay directly at the counter. After your visit, you can leave a review to help the community find the right place.
Mỗi đối tác đều được xét duyệt hồ sơ, dị: Every partner has their profile, services and price list reviewed before appearing on OAK Beauty.
Giá và thời lượng của từng dịch vụ được: The price and duration of every service are listed openly. No hidden fees, no deposits up front.
Chỉ khách đã hoàn thành lịch hẹn mới đượ: Only customers who have completed an appointment can leave a review, so ratings reflect genuine experiences.
Đổi ý là chuyện thường. Bạn có thể huỷ m: Changing your mind is normal. You can cancel free of charge up to 2 hours before your appointment.
Khám phá các salon quanh bạn, hoặc đưa s: Explore the salons around you, or bring your own salon onto OAK Beauty and start taking bookings.
